name: Craftsman's Writ: Gyromatic Micro-Adjuster
summary: A transferable Craftsman's Writ requests a Gyromatic Micro-Adjuster. It gives you a delivery location and payment details.

sections.title: The Writ
sections.body: The note is written in faded ink, and it names one Gyromatic Micro-Adjuster. You need the writ with you to complete the exchange, and its marked location is where the customer expects delivery.

faq.q: What does the writ ask for?
faq.answer: The customer requests one Gyromatic Micro-Adjuster.
The writ marks the delivery location on your map.

faq.q: What do I need to complete the exchange?
aliases: what do i need for writ
faq.answer: You need the writ in your possession to complete the transaction.
Yes. The note says the writ is transferable.

faq.q: Does the writ say how payment works?
faq.answer: The writ includes information about payment, but no amount is stated in its text.

attribution: In-game quest text: Craftsman's Writ: Gyromatic Micro-Adjuster
